maddeler.e:
ازدرين (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَيْنَ (izdarayna) /iz.da.raj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# اُزْدُرِينَ (uzdurīna) /uz.du.riː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# اِزْدَرِينَ (izdarīna) /iz.da.riː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
